description: S3EP-AC combines space-weather forecasting modules to identify periods when a significant solar energetic-particle event is unlikely. Its present emphasis is an all-clear classification based on non-flaring or weakly flaring regions. The resource is documented by Georgia State University. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. SEP Watch and SEP Warning functions are described as later development phases. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
